cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Prove We’re Close
cards.instruction: Get someone to take a social or emotional risk that demonstrates trust in the connection.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Come to the reunion with me. Let them see us arrive holding hands.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They still think we're just friends.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I know. I want us to trust each other in that room too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Last time someone asked, you let go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll introduce you as my partner. Will you keep hold while I say it?
